title: Outbound mail log
summary: MyAPES Account now keeps a short, privacy-safe record of which emails were sent, and Admins can read it.
changes: Record each sent or failed email with its template, time, mailer, and the recipient's email domain.
Never store full addresses, subjects, message text, links, or tokens; addresses are kept only as a one-way hash.
Delete records older than 90 days every day, and show the log under Admin, Emails.
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.42 line: an additive log table and a read-only Admin page.
validation: composer pre-merge on the pull request branch.
known_limitations: Failures are recorded only when the mail channel reports them; a message rejected later by a recipient's server is not tracked.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. The new outbound_mail_logs table is left in place and ignored by the previous release.
